listing.name: The Simpsons: Hit & Run / Native Linux / zeropaulsy
listing.summary: A Linux 64-Bit build of The Simpsons Hit & Run using Vulkan 1.3/OpenGL 3.3. Running on X11 and Wayland, with widescreen, high resolutions, anti-aliasing, anisotropic filtering, controllers and optional post-processing shaders.
